ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs in a loose, fluffy mound covering the right side of the plate, bright yellow with orange-yellow tones and some darker golden streaks, soft, moist-looking curds with slight sheen, spread about 10 cm across and 2 cm high, sitting beside the other items on the white plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Pale white-to-cream chunky pieces with a slightly rubbery, firm-looking surface, irregular folded clumps about 2-3 cm each, covering the upper-left portion of the plate roughly 10 cm across and 2 cm high, with a few yellow-tinged edges, sitting next to the sausage pieces | 110
ITEM 3 | Six small cylindrical pieces, reddish-brown to dark tan with glossy, slightly oily sheen and a smooth, firm skin, each about 2-2.5 cm in diameter and 1.5-2 cm tall, clustered in a curved row on the left-center of the plate, with one browned edge visible | 90
